title: The Bowling Alley Secret

Comment "WISH" and I'll send you the 14 Your Wish Is Your Command audios, free.

Kevin Trudeau says he could read energy before he could tie his own shoes. At six years old, at a bowling alley in his hometown, a stranger walked up and named exactly what he was seeing in a dark corner of the room.

That stranger didn't call it strange. He made an offer.

What came after split Kevin's life in two - one half public, one half hidden - for decades, and ended with him standing in rooms most people only read about.
